summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised CSS theme
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS/theme helper for ThoughtSpot embedding but ships a `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, uses a local `bun` if present, otherwise downloads a pinned Bun v1.3.13 binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, chmods it executable in a temp directory, and invokes it on a co-shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle with hex-obfuscated identifiers, a rotated string/opcode array, and a base64-shaped decoder — no source map or readable identifiers. The payload is reached only through the preinstall→Bun path and is not referenced by the library's `main` (`dist/index.js`), which is an unrelated CSS theme. Executing a second, alien runtime on an obfuscated blob at install time bypasses Node-based inspection and has no relationship to the advertised CSS/theme functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
